title: Cr(III)-salophen catalysts: efficient single-component and binary systems for sustainable CO2/cyclohexene oxide copolymerization
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,46727-46736
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08569A, Paper

Daniela Fonseca-López, David Ezenarro-Salcedo, Javier Martínez, René S. Rojas, John J. Hurtado
Cr(III) and Co(III) complexes catalyzed the copolymerization of CO2 with cyclohexene oxide. Cat5 was tested as a single-component system and showed high selectivity toward poly(cyclohexene carbonate) (PCHC) at 61%.
